visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length reddish-brown hair, wearing a pink long-sleeved button-down shirt and a black skirt, walks towards an old upright piano located in a semi-outdoor sheltered area. She smiles broadly and opens the keyboard lid with both hands. The setting appears to be a ground-floor entrance with concrete flooring and natural daylight coming from the left. (2) A close-up shows her fingers pressing down on the yellowed piano keys. She then stands back with her hands behind her back, tilting her head with an exaggerated expression of mock disappointment as she looks at the camera. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (3) An older woman in a brown sweater enters the frame from the left, standing next to the young woman. She makes a circular gesture with her hands and leans in as if apologizing. The background shows a rural road and green trees through the open doorway. (4) The scene cuts to a group shot of four women standing in a line, dancing rhythmically by swaying and moving their arms. An older man in a grey vest and a cap sits at a table in the background, watching them while holding a glass. (5) Multiple fast cuts follow, showing the group of women, labeled as three sisters and the younger woman, dancing enthusiastically. The young woman returns to the piano, dancing while sitting on the bench. The video ends with everyone raising their hands and cheering in a group pose.
